title: Wire tie is great for many things
text: Wire tie is great for many things. This is great for tying plants to stop from dropping.  It's also great for tying pretty much anything without damaging the item. The wire holds it in place and the rubber coating protects the item.  It's not very long, but it serves the purpose.
